name: empire_yields_by_city
description: Per-city yields (food, production, gold, science, culture, faith) and empire totals for one alive player, read from the simulation (City:GetYield, gross per turn). Use for 'which city makes the most X' or empire yield totals. Params: playerId (default local player; must be in PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()), sortBy (yield name, highest first).

sortBy.description: sort cities by this yield, highest first

lua:
-- Per-city yields for one player, read from the simulation (GameCore_Tuner).
-- P.playerId: player id (default: the local player). Must be alive.
-- P.sortBy:   optional yield name (food, production, gold, science, culture, faith) to sort cities by, highest first.
local pid = P.playerId
if pid == nil then pid = Game.GetLocalPlayer() end
local alive = PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()
local found = false
for _, id in ipairs(alive) do
  if id == pid then found = true end
end
if not found then
  emitJson({ ok = false, error = 'player ' .. tostring(pid) .. ' is not an alive player id', alive = alive })
  return
end
local names = { 'FOOD', 'PRODUCTION', 'GOLD', 'SCIENCE', 'CULTURE', 'FAITH' }
local rows, totals = {}, {}
for _, c in Players[pid]:GetCities():Members() do
  local r = { id = c:GetID(), name = L(c:GetName()), x = c:GetX(), y = c:GetY(), pop = c:GetPopulation() }
  for _, y in ipairs(names) do
    local key = string.lower(y)
    local v = c:GetYield(YieldTypes[y]) or 0
    r[key] = math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10
    totals[key] = (totals[key] or 0) + v
  end
  rows[#rows + 1] = r
end
for k, v in pairs(totals) do totals[k] = math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10 end
local sortBy = P.sortBy and string.lower(P.sortBy) or nil
if sortBy ~= nil and totals[sortBy] ~= nil then
  table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a[sortBy] or 0) > (b[sortBy] or 0) end)
end
emitJson({ ok = true, playerId = pid, cityCount = #rows, sortedBy = sortBy, totals = totals, cities = rows, note = 'yields are the game values from City:GetYield (gross, per turn), rounded to 0.1' })
